rows.notes: The study is a meta-analysis of 29 published studies (3130 Dra and 1303 CU observations), not a primary study, so Q1 is 'no' and all other questions are 'no' by rule. Substantively, its pooled results do show Dra and CU declining with cumulative operation time under reclaimed wastewater drip (Dra 96.1%/CU 93.3% at <125 h falling to 64.2%/58.1% at 375-500 h, below acceptable thresholds), with 95% CIs and subgroup analyses by water quality and emitter parameters, which matches the passage's description; but as a synthesis of others' data it does not count as own evidence under the rating rules.
